name: golden_v2
purpose: The eval set for harness and checkpoint decisions (successor of golden_v1). Never train on any listed task or repo.
protocol: Runs: python -m v2.eval.golden_ab --golden v2 --arm <greedy harness> --out results/arms/<name> --seeds 5 (standard vLLM, Kaggle-faithful; greedy runs are NOT repeatable, so >= 5 runs per arm; add runs to an existing arm with --seed-offset <runs so far> --seeds <n>). Decision: python -m v2.eval.golden_ab --golden v2 --anchor-arm A --candidate-arm B --out results/<ab> --seeds 5. Statistic: per task, mean solve rate over the runs; paired per-task difference (candidate - anchor); repo-clustered bootstrap (resample repos, then tasks within repos; 10,000 replicates) of the pooled and per-part mean difference, CI90; sign test over tasks whose means differ; per-run pooled solve-rate SD per arm reported as the run-to-run noise floor.

promote_rule.rule: promote iff pooled CI90 lower bound > 0 AND comp-part mean delta >= 0 AND >= 5 runs per arm
promote_rule.replaces: v1 rule (pooled per-seed McNemar p<=0.10, repo-cluster CI90 lower >= 0, comp delta >= 0, 2 seeds): greedy runs on standard vLLM are not repeatable, so per-seed McNemar over 2 seeds overstated significance (coordinator finding 2026-11-06)

empty_patch_passes_nondiscriminative.explanation: The unpatched repository already passes every verification test (2/2 empty runs resolved). fastapi_14077: the test_patch only replaces status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY with the literal 422, which passes before and after the fix. fastapi_14851: the new on_event/lifespan tests pass on the base commit with the environment's Starlette 0.52.1; the re-implementation only matters for a future Starlette. Changing Starlette would change the environment of every other FastAPI task. The task carries no signal.

grader_disables_anyio_async_tests.explanation: Three verification tests in tests/test_router_include_context.py are `async def` tests that need the anyio pytest plugin; the official grading command forces `-p no:anyio` (and rewrites pytest.ini to the same), so they fail with 'async def functions are not natively supported' under the gold patch. Fixing this would mean changing the grader, not the environment.

required_test_pydantic_v1_only.explanation: The grader requires every test function added by the test_patch to pass; the added test_model_description_escaped_with_formfeed[True|False] is skipped ('requires Pydantic v1') in the shared Pydantic 2 environment, so the gold patch can never resolve. Pydantic v1 cannot be installed alongside v2 without changing every other FastAPI task.

network_none_tarpit_and_httpbin.explanation: All eight grade tests/test_requests.py, which contains TestTimeout::test_connect_timeout / test_total_timeout_connect against the TARPIT 10.255.255.1: the official sandbox runs with network_mode=none, so the connect fails immediately with ENETUNREACH (ConnectionError) instead of timing out (ConnectTimeout). The file also needs the pytest-httpbin plugin (tests/conftest.py overrides its `httpbin` fixture, ~190 errors), which swegemma deliberately never injects; requests_6757 additionally has two TLS-bundle tests that fail offline. The connect-timeout failures cannot be fixed without changing the grader's network policy or faking socket behaviour, so the task cannot pass under the official path.

pygments_version_dependent_expectations.explanation: With the repo checkout imported, the gold patch still fails test_syntax/test_markdown rendering tests whose expected ANSI output encodes the token colours of the Pygments release the tests were written against (e.g. function-call names coloured 248;248;242 vs 166;226;46 with Pygments 2.21.0). The grader uses one image for all tasks; no single Pygments satisfies these and the 39 Rich tasks that pass (several of them also render Syntax), so these are left out rather than pinned per task.

python313_semantics.explanation: Python 3.13 (the competition image) behaviour: rich_3472 test_attrs_broken_310 expects the pre-3.13 AttributeError message (3.13 includes the qualified class name); rich_3486's required test test_traceback_finely_grained_missing is skipped ('Not applicable after Python 3.11'), so the grader's required-test check fails under the gold patch.

controls.rule: valid iff 2/2 empty runs unresolved, 2/2 gold runs resolved, identical verdicts and identical per-test JUnit outcomes across repeats, and the agent sandbox imports the repo checkout
